title: Normalized realization integral scalar comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite normed extensions $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a specified $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $i:E\to F$, any scheme $W$, and two normalized realization records $A_E,A_F$ [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization-records]. For every pro-etale test object $U\to W$, integral continuous section $b$ over $U$, and point $x\in U$, the value of the section obtained by applying $A_E.integralIso^{-1}$, the residue-normalized completed scalar map [lem-pbc-scalar-tensor-construction], and $A_F.integralIso$ is $i(b(x))$ in $F$.

source.place: Definition 6.8.1 and Lemma 6.8.2(1), with the profinite-test identification in Lemma 4.2.12. Agent-written normalized coefficient-chart argument for setup proof Step 12.

proof.text: Identify each finite chart by its values on constant sections. The normalization, the constant-sheaf universal property and the normalized finite function-scalar unit identify it with the discrete continuous-function comparison, followed by the canonical lifted quotient isomorphism. Derive the finite scalar-unit identity directly from the recorded finiteRingComparison and pbcLevelConstantComparison equations, so no derived smooth-exchange theorem is needed.

Naturality of the constant-sheaf comparison proves the coefficient-extension square at each finite level. Conjugate the actual scalar quotient map by the normalized lifted quotient isomorphisms. On a valuation-ring representative this is reduction of its image under i. The completed scalar map projection equation and the integral chart normalization give equality of every positive residue of the two integral values.

Use the existing valuation-ring equivalence with its compatible positive residue family. Its injectivity identifies the two integral values. Apply the valuation-ring inclusion to obtain equality in F. All statements are pointwise, including empty test objects.

theorem normalizedRealizationIntegralScalar
    (AE : CondensedERealization.At l E W) (AF : CondensedERealization.At l F W)
    (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (b : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.integralCoefficientSheaf l W E).obj.obj U)
    (x : U.unop.left) :
    (integralCoefficientValue l F W U
      ((AE.integralIso.inv ≫ pbcScalarCoefficientMap l E F i W ≫ AF.integralIso.hom).hom.app
        U b) x).val = i (integralCoefficientValue l E W U b x).val
